en.headline: Daily GitHub Activity Report for 2026-10-03
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, the user made 3 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, adding a daily GitHub activity report feature (Pages + SenseNova AI), enabling manual date specification in the CI workflow via workflow_dispatch, and fixing report submission wording and page issues. There were also 2 automated commits in sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator. The user opened 3 issues in openchamber/openchamber: #4337 (docs pointing to a removed sidebar header button, later closed by btriapitsyn), #4345 (command palette icon conflict), and #4346 (test still passing after removal of onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun). The openchamber-bot replied to #4337 and #4345 with fix-ready analysis tracing the root causes. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.
